# Elevated Gene Expression in Mammal Forebrains
The human protein atlas maps all human proteins. 
This page is finding the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in **humans, pigs and mice**
The forebrain includes the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus
```{r}
total_elevated_forebrain_genes_humans <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_elevated_forebrain_genes_humans)

total_elevated_forebrain_genes_pigs <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_elevated_forebrain_genes_pigs)

total_elevated_forebrain_genes_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_elevated_forebrain_genes_mouse)

print("Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain")
```
